verdict.rationale: Pulley supports e-signing documents directly on the platform (pulley-docs-33), collecting signatures without third-party e-sign tools (pulley-docs-9), customizing stock certificates (pulley-docs-35), and tracking signature/acceptance status tied to securities (pulley-docs-30). This strongly implies certificates are signed and linked to cap table entries, but there's no explicit documentation confirming certificates are 'legally signed' with legal validity assurances or explicit permanent linkage architecture beyond the status tracker. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of legal enforceability/validity of in-platform signatures, and detailed description of the permanent data linkage between certificate and cap table record.
